empty_cell: An empty cell means 'not declared in the model' and nothing else; a collection is always written, [] or {} when it declares no member; what is unmapped is a status column's explicit value, never an empty cell.

tables.row_id: component:<Type>, one row per component type

columns.name: row_id
columns.meaning: The row's stable identity: names only, never a task, period, partition, core, file or comment.

columns.name: component
columns.meaning: The component type's name.

columns.name: kind
columns.meaning: The component type's kind: application, service or ecu_abstraction.

columns.name: external
columns.meaning: Whether the component is declared external: true or false.

columns.name: asil_declared
columns.meaning: The safety level the component declares; empty when it declares none.

columns.name: asil_effective
columns.meaning: The effective safety level: the declared one, else the highest level of the requirements allocated to the component; QM when nothing is allocated.

columns.name: memory
columns.meaning: The component's declared memory map, memory name to bytes, as a JSON object.

columns.name: satisfies
columns.meaning: The requirement links the component declares, as written, as a JSON list.

columns.name: occurrences
columns.meaning: How many occurrences of the type the root composition reaches.

columns.name: runnables
columns.meaning: How many runnables the type declares.

columns.name: description
columns.meaning: The description as written in the model.

columns.name: source_ref
columns.meaning: The file declaring the component type, relative to model_root (not a fact; not hashed).

columns.name: facts_hash
columns.meaning: The first 16 hex digits of sha256 over the row's table, revision, row_id and fact columns.

columns.name: verification_method
columns.meaning: The test side's: how the row is verified. SWCraft carries it, never writes it.

columns.name: comment
columns.meaning: The test side's comment. SWCraft carries it, never writes it.

columns.name: accepted
columns.meaning: The test side's verdict: yes, no or empty. A comment or a method alone accepts nothing.

columns.name: accepted_facts_hash
columns.meaning: The facts_hash the verdict refers to; none when no facts could be found. Clear it to accept the current facts.

columns.name: review_state
columns.meaning: Computed by SWCraft: not-reviewed, accepted, rejected, or stale when the verdict refers to other facts.
